BiblicalUsage: Chaliytsah is spoil, armour stripped from the fallen. Samson went down to Ashkelon and took their spoil to pay his wager, and Abner told Asahel to take one of the young men and take his armour instead of chasing him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe spoil is the wage of war, and both verses show men reaching for it instead of reaching for what matters.
